from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
from scipy.ndimage import map_coordinates, gaussian_filter
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
im=np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png')).astype(float)
s=gaussian_filter(im[:,:,0]-im[:,:,1],.75)
th=np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,72,endpoint=False);r=np.linspace(25,45,161)
x=188+np.cos(th)[:,None]*r[None,:];y=227+np.sin(th)[:,None]*r[None,:]*.91
val=map_coordinates(s,[y,x],order=1)
der=np.gradient(val,axis=1)
ids=np.argmin(der,axis=1);px=x[np.arange(len(th)),ids];py=y[np.arange(len(th)),ids]
def fun(p):
 cx,cy,rx,ry,k=p
 X=(px-cx)*np.cos(k)+(py-cy)*np.sin(k);Y=-(px-cx)*np.sin(k)+(py-cy)*np.cos(k)
 return (X/rx)**2+(Y/ry)**2-1
res=least_squares(fun,[188,227,38,33.5,.2],loss='soft_l1',f_scale=.1)
print(res.x, 'residual',np.std(fun(res.x)))
for i in range(0,72,6): print(round(th[i]*180/np.pi),round(px[i],2),round(py[i],2),round(val[i,ids[i]],2))
print('cov smoothing values')
PY"
